messages:
lee: Heads-up — after yesterday's FP8 kernel rollout on the H100 fleet (transformer-engine v2.14) we're seeing intermittent pipeline stalls for long-context workloads. p50 unchanged, but p99 spikes ~2x on L40S/H100 mixed pools. attaching flame snippet in-thread.

maria: ugh. saw a customer's trace show repeated kernel fallback to slowpath. think it's happening when kv-cache hits and sequence len > 8k.

sachin: can you paste the flame? also which kernel selector was active? we toggled the hybrid-transpose selector last night.

lee: paste of trimmed trace: ```
GPU0: fp8_gemm_transpose_kernel (fastpath) -> 12ms
GPU0: fp8_dotprod_slowpath (fallback) -> 120ms
GPU0: kv_replay_task -> 8ms (blocked)
CPU: batching_dispatch -> waiting 110ms
```

lee: selector config: `kernel_selector: hybrid_transpose_v2; threshold.seq_len: 2048; occupancy_low_thresh: 0.45`

maria: that matches: selector picks fastpath when occupancy high, but with KV replay the occupancy estimate is wrong (we're undercounting inflight microbatches) so it flips to slowpath mid-request. leads to pipeline flush.

infra-bot: deploy 2765429000 rolled FP8 kernels to pool=h100-prod-2 by @maria (canary 5% -> 100%)

taylor: repro steps I used locally: run long-chat harness with kv_hotset=on, concurrency=8, microbatch=4, seq=8192. saw same fallback sequence. added a microprofiler sample: `kernel_decision_time` spikes right before fallback.

sachin: hypothesis: batching heuristic computes effective occupancy using queued tokens, but when KV cache re-inserts prefix tokens the token accounting is stale and kernel_selector mispredicts. need to adjust `batching_heuristic.window` or make selector consult KV hit-rate.

maria: agreed. quick mitigation: force selector to prefer fastpath for seq_len >= 4096 on H100 until we fix accounting. That reduces p99 but increases minor memory. Want to push a patch?

lee: +1 for mitigation. but we should keep an eye on quality: FP8 fastpath + different GEMM layout had tiny calibration drift in evals. not huge but present.

taylor: perf numbers from my run (canary vs rollback):
- canary (hybrid_transpose_v2): p50=48ms, p95=220ms, p99=480ms
- mitigation (force-fastpath-large-seq): p50=50ms, p95=210ms, p99=260ms
- rollback to int8-fallback: p50=60ms, p95=240ms, p99=270ms

maria: so mitigation gets p99 close to rollback but keeps throughput. small perf/quality tradeoff. I'll open a small PR to gate selector by kv_hit_rate and add a server flag `force_fp8_fastpath_for_large_seq`.

lee: also add a telemetry tag when fallback occurs: `fp8_fallback_reason=kv_eviction|occupancy_mispred|quant_clip`. we need histograms.

infra-bot: perf-alert created: PERF-1458 "FP8 kernel fallback spikes on long-context; H100/L40S" assigned to @maria, @sachin

sachin: follow-ups: (1) add KV-aware occupancy estimator (2) unit test for microbatch accounting with kv_replay (3) run calibration evals on the forced-fastpath config to detect regressions.

maria: will do. plan to push mitigation to canary in 30m and run regression harness. posting logs after run. :rocket:

lee: thanks. please add any weird traces here. if we see replays >3 per request we should auto-fallback whole pod to int8 until patched.

maria: noted. will update in thread.

taylor: one more note — transformer-engine config had `max_parallel_warps=32` in v2.14 which might amplify occupancy misreadings on L40S; will test softer setting.

lee: perfect. good triage. :thumbsup:
